question: Where are the upasaṃdohakas located and which are named?
premises: The upasaṃdohakas are eight in number.
They correspond to the junctions of the heart-lotus petals.
Jālandhara, Naipāla, Kaśmīra, Gargikā, and Hara are named among them.
inference: The upasaṃdohakas form an eightfold set mapped to the petal junctions of the heart-lotus.
uncertainties: Only five names appear in this verse; the rest continue in the next.
plain_english: The eight upasaṃdohakas correspond to the junctions of the heart-lotus petals: Jālandhara, Naipāla, Kaśmīra, Gargikā, and Hara.
